newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate buyer inquiry.
There were 26,600 head confirmed for the week to date which was formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Confirmed - None Last Week - None Year Ago - None
Wk to Date - 26,600 Last Week - 33,400 Year Ago - 17,300
The last established price was $66.00 per cwt on last Thursday. Monday's packer bids were $65.00, with asking prices $67.00-$68.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
